_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-07-02 · Session 96 · Master + Custom Reports now pull LIVE card updates · report links fresh daily · attach flow explained
_status: Report day. Both report generators now read the same live data the cards show: the Custom Report folds in the latest posted updates + Team & RACI leads before it writes, and the Master Report button opens a checkbox picker (activities AND project cards — your ask) that builds the Word doc right in the browser from live data. Behind the scenes we found why the old Master Report file was stale: the daily robot never had the Word library installed (it failed silently every night) and never saved the reports it made — both fixed, so the per-card Report buttons refresh daily again. Your three tweaks landed too: the update popup saves-and-closes, nudge emails use semicolons for Outlook, and the two trend graphs sit at the bottom of CPL Analytics now. On attachments: the 📎 button explains itself now (it hands off to SharePoint's ＋ Create or upload) — but note some newer projects (like 4.1.4) never got a SharePoint folder, so the popover also links the parent folder. Everything ships with the next rebuild.
